item.advancedenchanting.table_upgrade.ti: Right-click a normal enchanting table to upgrade it
gui.advancedenchanting.insert: Put an item or a book into the slot
gui.advancedenchanting.tip.title: Advanced Enchanting Table
gui.advancedenchanting.tip.slider: Slide right for a higher level, left for a lower one or to remove it. Paid in experience points.
gui.advancedenchanting.tip.colors: Green rows can be changed, red ones can't (they clash with a chosen enchantment).
gui.advancedenchanting.tip.curses: Curses only at midnight under a full moon.
gui.advancedenchanting.tip.curses_open: It's midnight under a full moon - curses are available!
gui.advancedenchanting.reason.conflict: Not compatible with the chosen enchantments
gui.advancedenchanting.reason.curse: Curses only at midnight under a full moon
gui.advancedenchanting.reason.treasure: The table doesn't apply treasure enchantments
